description: This file defines the OAuthToken class, which manages OAuth tokens within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for generating, saving, loading, and invalidating tokens, as well as handling associated OAuth logic such as nonce validation and token creation.

classes.name: OAuthToken
classes.description: Represents an OAuth token with methods for lifecycle management, association with consumers and users, and authorization workflows within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new OAuthToken object with optional token and secret values, setting its state to REQUEST.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the state of the token (REQUEST, ACCESS, INVALID).

methods.name: setConsumer
methods.description: Associates the token with an OAuthKey consumer object.

methods.name: setCallbackURL
methods.description: Sets the callback URL for request tokens.

methods.name: randomValue
methods.description: Generates a secure random token or secret.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates a new OAuthToken with randomly generated token and secret.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the token to the database, setting timestamp and ID as needed.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Retrieves a token by its ID, loading associated consumer data.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Marks the token as invalid and saves.

methods.name: createAuthorized
methods.description: Creates and returns an authorized access token for a specific user and consumer.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Generates a verification string, sets auth data, and associates user, effectively authorizing the token.

methods.name: copyAuthData
methods.description: Copies auth data and user association from another token.

methods.name: queryString
methods.description: Returns the OAuth token and secret as a URL query string.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes stale invalid and request tokens from the database.

methods.name: checkNonce
methods.description: Validates a nonce to prevent replay attacks, updating the nonce store.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Deletes the token record from the database by ID.

methods.name: deleteByConsumer
methods.description: Removes all tokens associated with a given consumer ID.

methods.name: deleteByUser
methods.description: Removes all tokens associated with a given user ID.
